query: What is the processing time for visa application?
reference_answer: The processing time is within three (3) working days, excluding the day of submission. Some applications may take longer to process, especially during peak periods.You can use the Enquire Application Status function to check on the progress of your application.
answer: Without specific information, the processing time for a visa application can vary widely depending on the type of visa and country. Typically, it takes several weeks to months. [Document 1]
